h1: Rimtalay Resort Koh Larn — Pay Hundreds, Get a Million-Dollar View, Every Room Faces the Sea
intro: If your dream is waking up, opening the curtains and finding the sea filling the whole frame — with white-and-blue photo corners to shoot all day — Rimtalay Resort Koh Larn is the small island resort many guests sum up as "pay hundreds, get a million-dollar view." · It sits in Na Ban village on the side that faces back toward Pattaya, every room looks out to sea, and there's a rooftop pool, a jacuzzi and a private pier reaching into the water for fishing and photos · Breakfast is included · Scored 8.6 from 132 reviews, from approx. ฿1,800/night.

body.html: What guests talk about most at Rimtalay Resort Koh Larn is the sea view you get from every room · The resort sits in Na Ban village on the side facing back toward Pattaya, decorated in a Mediterranean white-and-blue theme, and stepping out of your room you're met with the sea filling the frame · The grounds are fairly large for Koh Larn, with several zones, plenty of photo corners and a private pier reaching into the water where you can sit, fish or catch the sunset — which is exactly why many people pick it for a quiet, photogenic stay.

There are several room types, from an upper-floor Sea View room up to villas such as the Atlantic Blue / Pacific Green Ocean Villa and a King Suite with an in-room spa bath · Reviews regularly praise the comfortable beds, the photogenic decor and the breakfast that's included in the rate, which many guests rate highly · On top of that there's a rooftop pool and jacuzzi for soaking with a sea view, an on-site cafe, and at times a seafood buffet that guests find good value.
"Hundreds of baht but a view worth a fortune — every room faces the sea, so many photo spots, comfy beds, good breakfast and staff who look after you."

Real guest reviews point the same way: great value with a view that punches above the price · The overall score sits at 8.6 in the "very good" band, with couples rating it especially high (around 9.2) thanks to the quiet, private feel that suits a two-person getaway · The main praise lands on the view, the decor, the breakfast and the staff, while some rooms also stand out for their in-room spa baths and sea-facing balconies.

What to know before booking is the finer detail of upkeep · Some reviews mention low water pressure in certain rooms, bathrooms that feel a bit dark in places, and an entrance path that's quite dark at night — walking to the convenience store can feel a little spooky · A few also note that parts of the resort weren't fully open or were being worked on, and that some staff could be friendlier · These are the kind of details you'll find at small island stays, and they don't undercut an overall picture most guests are happy with.

The other thing to understand is the location · Rimtalay is on the Na Ban side facing Pattaya, not a white-sand swimming beach like Tawaen or Samae · Its strengths are the sea view and the photo-worthy setting, not a swim beach right in front of the resort · If you want clear water to swim in, you'll still need a songthaew or a rented motorbike across to the beaches on the other side (about 10 minutes) · But if the goal is to relax quietly, watch the sea, take great photos and soak in the jacuzzi with a view — this location works.

Honestly, Rimtalay Resort Koh Larn is best for people who come to Koh Larn to relax and shoot photos rather than to charge into the water · Picture a couple or a group of friends who want a sea-view room, photogenic corners, a rooftop pool and a pier to lounge on, and a good breakfast — then head out to explore the beaches the next day · It delivers that well at a price that's still reachable · But if you want a resort right on a sandy beach you can walk straight into the sea from, or a bright, strong-pressure bathroom like a brand-new hotel, compare it against the stays on the Tawaen or Samae beach side first.

On price, Sea View rooms start at about ฿1,800/night on weekdays (breakfast included) · Villas and the suite with a spa bath climb into the several-thousand-to-five-figure range depending on the room type and season · Weekends and long holidays push rates up and fill the rooms fast · Book ahead and compare a few platforms (Agoda / Trip.com) to lock in a normal-season rate and the exact room type you want.

tips.title: Ask for an upper-floor sea-view room
tips.body: Every room faces the sea, but upper floors have a more open view and better Pattaya-side sunsets — request it at booking.

tips.title: Want a tub? Pick a villa/suite
tips.body: For a spa-bath soak with a sea view, choose the King Suite with SPA Bath or an Ocean Villa, as standard Sea View rooms have no tub.

tips.title: Rent a motorbike for the beaches
tips.body: Tawaen and Samae beaches are about 10 minutes away; the resort sometimes runs a shuttle/boat — ask. Motorbike hire is around ฿300/day.

tips.title: Bring a phone light for the night
tips.body: The entrance path is quite dark at night, so a phone torch makes the walk to the convenience store more comfortable.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Rimtalay Resort Koh Larn

faq.q: Where is Rimtalay Resort Koh Larn on the island?
faq.a: It sits at 170/22 Moo 7, Koh Larn, Bang Lamung, Chon Buri, in Na Ban village on the side that faces back toward Pattaya · Its draw is that every room faces the sea, with white-and-blue photo corners across the resort · It isn't a sandy beach you walk straight into; for swimming at Tawaen or Samae you'll need a ride or rented motorbike (about 10 minutes).

faq.q: How much does Rimtalay Resort Koh Larn cost?
faq.a: Sea View rooms start at about ฿1,800/night on weekdays, breakfast included · Villas and the King Suite with a spa bath climb into the several-thousand-to-five-figure range depending on room type and season · Rates rise and rooms fill fast on holidays, so compare a few platforms (Agoda / Trip.com) before booking.

faq.q: Does Rimtalay Resort Koh Larn have a pool?
faq.a: Yes — a rooftop pool and a jacuzzi for soaking with a sea view · There's also a private pier reaching into the water for sitting, fishing and photos · Some rooms, such as the King Suite, also have an in-room spa bath.

faq.q: Does every room really have a sea view?
faq.a: Most rooms are sea-view, in line with the resort's concept of facing the sea toward Pattaya · There are a few Garden View rooms that cost less and have no tub · For the most open sea view, choose an upper-floor room and request it at booking.

faq.q: How do I get to Rimtalay Resort Koh Larn?
faq.a: Take the ferry from Bali Hai Pier in Pattaya to Na Ban Pier on Koh Larn (about 45 minutes) · From the pier the resort is a short songthaew ride or walk · The resort sometimes offers a transfer — ask at booking · On the island, motorbike hire (around ฿300/day) is the easiest way to tour the beaches.

faq.q: Who is Rimtalay Resort Koh Larn best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for couples and travellers who come to relax and take photos, wanting a sea-view room, photogenic corners, a rooftop pool and jacuzzi to soak in, and a good breakfast in a quiet, private setting · It's less ideal if you want a resort right on a sandy beach to swim from, or a bright, strong-pressure bathroom like a brand-new hotel.
